title: Fastned: Tesla Model Y Long Range (2022 - 2025) charge curve
notes: Same Fastned Tesla page family, Model Y filter. Curve measured on Fastned's European CCS2 network, battery about 30 C, chargeSpeed 250 kW, graph class 300 kW.
